address: Haarlemmerweg 940-1060, Amsterdam (Westerpark corner of the Haarlemmerweg corridor): a 2023 white-panel high-rise, 16 storeys, with a regular grid of tall windows on a pale composite-panel skin, a glazed ground floor carrying the Gymbase Westerpark front, and a cantilevered crown block above a dark recessed band

walls.street: north front on the Haarlemmerweg; the Gymbase Westerpark entrance and its fascia sit on this wall

notes: Haarlemmerweg 940-1060 (BAG pand 0363100012250972, built 2023, 802 m2 footprint, eaves 46.9 m, 16 storeys at 2.93 m). Photographed after completion: the north wall in 2025-07-01 (recording_2025-07-01_09-03-48_00772, 35.9 m, 3.2 deg obliquity, 21% foliage) and the south wall in 2025-09-26 (2025_09_26_05_36_39_00285, 50.8 m, 0.6 deg, 29% foliage). The 2019/2022 crops of the same walls show the 1970s concrete block that stood here before and the 2022 scaffolding, so none of them is evidence for this model.

walls[0] = panel 8 (north, surface 10, 22.6 m): the entrance front. Pale composite panels with a regular grid of tall windows (about 0.9 x 1.9 m at 2.7 m pitch, dark frames), a glazed ground floor with the Gymbase Westerpark fascia and entrance. walls[1] = panel 14 (south, surface 17, 21.8 m) and walls[2] = panel 17 (east, surface 20, 35.5 m, measured at 51.6 deg obliquity so its numbers are coarse) and walls[3] = panels 2 (west, surfaces 3 and 4, 34 m, no panorama reaches it: the W face looks over the canal and the deck).

Simplified: the white panel skin is exported as render with a measured pale tint (the panel joints are not drawn), the windows are punched plain openings in that skin. Not drawn: the cantilevered white crown that overhangs the east corner above a dark recessed band (a 3DBAG extrusion cannot overhang, and the kit has no cantilever component), the inset upper balconies behind that band, the roof plant enclosure edges and the ground-floor shop glazing subdivisions.

Measured 2026-10-20 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 0, 1 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[0] glass #4879a0 not used (not darker than the wall #7ca9bf by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[1] wall split #3c3a2d | #a3a8a5 at 35 % (dE 40.6).

palette hand-held: the 2025 north crop is strongly blue-cast (measure.ts reads #7ca9bf for a white panel wall) and the south crop reads #d9d9d5 raw, so the light panel colour is taken from the south crop and the two are kept the same rather than measuring a cast.
